mapper.sql: id, applicant_id, relation, full_name, date_of_birth, nationality, deceased, note, company, position, company_address, phone, email

mapper.insert: insert into nad_applicant_personal (applicant_id, signature_media_id, signature_at, create_by, create_time) values (#{applicantId}, #{mediaId}, #{at}, '', now()) on duplicate key update signature_media_id = #{mediaId}, signature_at = #{at}, update_time = now()

insert into nad_applicant_personal (applicant_id, marital_status, religion, place_of_birth, official_language, permanent_address, permanent_postcode, create_by, create_time) values (#{applicantId}, #{maritalStatus}, #{religion}, #{placeOfBirth}, #{officialLanguage}, #{permanentAddress}, #{permanentPostcode}, '', now())
mapper.update: update nad_applicant_personal set marital_status = #{maritalStatus}, religion = #{religion}, place_of_birth = #{placeOfBirth}, official_language = #{officialLanguage}, permanent_address = #{permanentAddress}, permanent_postcode = #{permanentPostcode}, update_time = now() where applicant_id = #{applicantId}
mapper.select: select from nad_applicant_family_member where applicant_id = #{applicantId} order by field(relation, 'FATHER', 'MOTHER', 'SPOUSE', 'SIBLING', 'OTHER'), id
mapper.insert: insert into nad_applicant_family_member (applicant_id, relation, full_name, date_of_birth, nationality, deceased, note, company, position, company_address, phone, email, create_by, create_time) values (#{applicantId}, #{relation}, #{fullName}, #{dateOfBirth}, #{nationality}, #{deceased}, #{note}, #{company}, #{position}, #{companyAddress}, #{phone}, #{email}, '', now())
mapper.update: update nad_applicant_family_member set relation = #{relation}, full_name = #{fullName}, date_of_birth = #{dateOfBirth}, nationality = #{nationality}, deceased = #{deceased}, note = #{note}, company = #{company}, position = #{position}, company_address = #{companyAddress}, phone = #{phone}, email = #{email}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and applicant_id = #{applicantId}
mapper.delete: delete from nad_applicant_family_member where id = #{id} and applicant_id = #{applicantId}
mapper.select: select from nad_applicant_person where applicant_id = #{applicantId} and role = #{role}
mapper.insert: insert into nad_applicant_person (applicant_id, role, full_name, relationship, gender, email, phone, position, company, company_address, home_address, create_by, create_time) values (#{applicantId}, #{role}, #{fullName}, #{relationship}, #{gender}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{position}, #{company}, #{companyAddress}, #{homeAddress}, '', now())
mapper.update: update nad_applicant_person set full_name = #{fullName}, relationship = #{relationship}, gender = #{gender}, email = #{email}, phone = #{phone}, position = #{position}, company = #{company}, company_address = #{companyAddress}, home_address = #{homeAddress}, update_time = now() where applicant_id = #{applicantId} and role = #{role}
